about.heading: Why INOK
body: INOK stands for Idhu Namme Oru Kedai, Tamil for "this is our shop". Every participant came with a business of their own, and every lesson was about growing it.

Small businesses in the Malaysian Indian community often have strong products but little time or support to take them online. INOK was designed to change that: practical digital-marketing skills, taught in person, then applied to each participant's own business with a mentor alongside.

Over six days in Ipoh, participants worked through strategy, content, advertising, AI tools and marketplace selling with practitioners who run these campaigns for a living. They then spent 20 days putting it to work online, with a mentor checking in along the way.

The Program Pensijilan Digital Marketing Strategist was delivered by GET Academy with funding from MITRA, the Malaysian Indian Community Transformation Unit, and certified by SEGi College Subang Jaya, GET Academy's strategic educational partner within SEGi University & Colleges.

journey.heading: The 26-day journey

steps.title: Know yourself
steps.text: Digital-marketing fundamentals and a business persona for each participant, built around the one business they would grow all programme. First videos edited in CapCut.

steps.title: Know your product
steps.text: Facebook and Instagram pages set up, Google Ads, and ChatGPT for writing and planning content.

steps.title: Know your customer
steps.text: Hands-on video production: participants recorded and published informational videos on TikTok, in class.

steps.title: Know your place
steps.text: Choosing TikTok topics that sell, and running live-streams.

steps.title: Know your strategy
steps.text: Selling on Shopee and Lazada: choosing products, finding suppliers and setting up shop.

steps.title: Go viral
steps.text: A viral-marketing challenge, product branding, and live selling sessions on TikTok.

steps.title: Mentored implementation
steps.text: Back at their own shops, participants put the plan to work online with a mentor checking in.

steps.title: Certified
steps.text: Certificates issued by SEGi College Subang Jaya, GET Academy's strategic educational partner.

mitra.intro: MITRA, the Malaysian Indian Community Transformation Unit, funded INOK to give Malaysian Indian business owners real digital-marketing skills. GET Academy turned that funding into a complete programme: designed, taught, mentored and certified, end to end.

delivered.title: Built for the community MITRA serves
